name: fullstack-post-management
description: Full-Stack Post Management System with Google OAuth, RBAC, and JSONPlaceholder integration

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.lint: cd client && npm run lint && cd ../server && npm run lint
